postgres.description: PostgreSQL on a unix socket in the service directory; user postgres, no password
command: test -f "$SERVICE_DIR/data/PG_VERSION" || initdb -D "$SERVICE_DIR/data" -U postgres --auth=trust >/dev/null || exit 1; exec postgres -D "$SERVICE_DIR/data" -k "$SERVICE_DIR" -c listen_addresses=

redis.description: Redis on a unix socket in the service directory, without persistence
